title: ManeuverGear
description: A plugin that adds a working Spatial Maneuvering Device.
body:
ManeuverGear Plugin - The Ultimate Mobility Tool
Plugin Overview
The ManeuverGear plugin introduces the iconic 3D Maneuver Gear from Attack on Titan into your Minecraft server, providing players with an unparalleled mobility and combat experience. This isn't just a simple grappling hook; it's a deeply customizable system that allows server administrators to create multiple tiers of gear, each with unique attributes, recipes, and appearances.
From swinging through dense forests and scaling massive structures to engaging in high-speed aerial combat, this plugin transforms how players interact with the world.
Key Features
Fully Configurable Gear: Create unlimited types of Maneuver Gear (e.g., iron, diamond, netherite) directly through the configuration file or in-game commands. You can define every aspect:
Range, durability, and hook damage.
Crafting recipes.
Custom textures via CustomModelData.
Dynamic Dual-Hook Movement: Players can independently fire a left and a right hook, allowing for complex and skillful maneuvers. By anchoring to two points and managing their momentum, players can truly fly.
Integrated Combat System: The gear is not just for movement. Players can:
Damage entities by hitting them directly with a hook.
Perform a powerful Area-of-Effect (AoE) attack by right-clicking while both hooks are attached, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Durability and Cooldowns: To maintain balance, each gear has a configurable durability that depletes upon use. Hook firing and special attacks have separate, configurable cooldowns to prevent spam and encourage tactical gameplay.
In-Game Admin Management: A powerful suite of administrative commands allows for the creation, deletion, and real-time editing of gear types without needing to restart the server.
Command Reference
The plugin features two main commands: /3dmg for players and /3dmgadmin for server administrators.
Player Commands
Aliases: /mg, /maneuvergear
Description: Gives a player a specific type of Maneuver Gear.
Usage: /3dmg <type> [amount] [player]
Arguments:
<type> (Required): The unique ID of the gear as defined in config.yml (e.g., iron, diamond).
[amount] (Optional): The number of items to give. Defaults to 1.
[player] (Optional): The name of the player to give the item to. Defaults to the command sender.
Permissions:
3dmg.give: Allows a player to give gear to themselves.
3dmg.give.others: Allows a player to give gear to other players.
Admin Commands
Aliases: /mga
Description: The main command for managing and configuring all aspects of the ManeuverGear types directly in-game.
Permission: 3dmg.admin
Sub-commands:
/mga list
Description: Displays a list of all currently loaded gear IDs.
/mga info <id>
Description: Shows a detailed breakdown of all characteristics and attributes for a specific gear type.
Example: /mga info diamond
/mga create <id>
Description: Creates a new, disabled gear type in the config.yml with default values. You can then enable and configure it using the set command. Note: Crafting recipes must be configured manually in the config.yml file.
Example: /mga create emerald
/mga delete <id>
Description: Permanently deletes a gear type from the config.yml. This action cannot be undone.
Example: /mga delete emerald
/mga set <id> <attribute> <value>
Description: Sets a specific attribute for a gear type. This is the primary command for editing gear.
Example: /mga set iron damage 2.5
Available Attributes: display-name, material, custom-model-data, range, damage, durability, cooldown, aoe-damage, aoe-radius, aoe-cooldown.
/mga reload
Description: Reloads the config.yml file and registers all recipes. This is crucial for applying any manual changes made to the configuration, especially for crafting recipes.
